title: Logos 15 opening: Proverbs 8:22 — the Lord created me
english: Fifteenth discourse. On Proverbs 8:22, “The Lord created me a beginning of his ways.”
The Arian proof-text is met so that “created” does not make the Son a creature by nature.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
